name: DerivBench
description: Code, result files and verification scripts for the manuscript 'DerivBench: a calibrated benchmark for surrogate Jacobian accuracy under grouped distribution shift'. Six analytic engineering test functions with hand-derived gradients verified against central differences, and a lumped-parameter (0-D) thermochemical simulator differentiated by complex step, are used to compare value transfer and Jacobian transfer of nine learned surrogate implementations under group-disjoint evaluation. Includes the few-shot, source-only diagnostic, design-step endpoint (E12) and revised-MD17 stress-test scripts. The rMD17 data are not redistributed; they are available under CC0 from Figshare (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.12672038). Depends on numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas and matplotlib (mpmath for the extended-precision check).
